answer: Every established agent gets two sponsorship berths per season. A new identity gains voting weight only after a sponsor locks part of its own stake against that recruit for six epochs. If later clustering shows the recruit is a clone, the locked share is burned and both seats are revoked, so one patron cannot mint a herd. The lock is posted at a public registry wharf; the recruit's first jade of rewards stays escrowed until the window closes. A detected farm drives the sponsor's capital to a nadir, making careless endorsements costlier than staying idle.
